readiness_gates: all parent paths and sha256 values resolve exactly
preparation target packet records species, age, temperature, recording mode, solution, blockers, metric, uncertainty, source locator, and simulator units
every numerical acceptance bound has a primary-source locator or is explicitly labelled model-derived

candidate id, parameter digest, and effective parameters are bound through plan, job, runner, receipt, and result

valid scientific NO-GO is receipted with process success while infrastructure failure is distinct
controller enforces NumPy-before-CuPy calibration and seals each transition
all commands, inputs, outputs, manifests, and stage transitions pass a seed-free dry run

must_be_resolved_before_calibration: fast sodium and delayed-rectifier potassium gating kinetics and temperature scaling
SK calcium half-activation, Hill coefficient, and time constant

future_search_budget.promotion_rule: at each tier, retain hard-gate survivors ordered by preregistered normalized objective score descending, then candidate sha256 ascending; evaluate exactly the tier budget or issue scientific NO-GO if fewer survivors exist

selection_rule.space: all filed search parameters normalized to [0,1] by their preregistered low/high bounds; log-transformed parameters are normalized after log transform
selection_rule.distance: Euclidean distance in normalized parameter space
selection_rule.first: highest preregistered normalized objective score, candidate sha256 ascending as tie-break
selection_rule.iteration: choose the candidate maximizing its minimum distance to the already selected set
selection_rule.ties: preregistered normalized objective score descending, then candidate sha256 ascending

future_search_budget.early_stop: only scientific NO-GO when a tier has fewer survivors than its next exact budget or fewer than four final hard-gate survivors; infrastructure failure is retryable and does not consume the budget

verdicts.READINESS_GO: every readiness gate passes and a separate executable Stage B specification is source-sealed
verdicts.READINESS_UNDEFINED: any target, unit, parameter, scorer, candidate-binding, receipt, order, or dry-run gate is missing or invalid
verdicts.future_CALIBRATION_NO_GO: a valid receipted fixed-budget search yields fewer than four hard-gate survivors
verdicts.future_REPLICATION_NO_GO: any frozen survivor fails a required replication gate
verdicts.future_HELD_OUT_NO_GO: any frozen survivor fails a required held-out gate
verdicts.future_STAGE_B_GO: all four frozen survivors pass both backends, all replication seeds, all held-out seeds, all causal lesions, checkpoint, integrity, and scorer gates

stageB_go_authorizes: a separate Stage C shared continuous-selector preregistration only
